quarterly_data.quarter: Cisco press release: Cisco Advances Scalability and Openness at OCP 2026 (10-12-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Cisco says its 51.2T systems powered by Silicon One P200 are deployed in a production environment by leading hyperscalers (Cisco claims to be the first in the industry to announce this). In the release Alibaba Cloud (Dennis Cai, VP and Head of Network Infrastructure) says Alibaba has deployed its in-house Quantum Cat router at massive scale in its next-generation eCORE backbone network, powered by the Cisco Silicon One P200, bringing 51.2 Tbps of routing capacity, pairing Cisco's silicon with Alibaba's custom systems and the SONiC operating system.
quarterly_data.figure: Silicon One P200 51.2T systems in production at hyperscalers; Alibaba Quantum Cat routers with 51.2 Tbps routing capacity
quarterly_data.counterparty_role: customer (Silicon One P200 silicon in its in-house Quantum Cat backbone routers)

quarterly_data.quarter: Cisco press release: Cisco Advances Scalability and Openness at OCP 2026 (10-12-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: The 102.4T Silicon One G300 is now available for customer sampling and the first G300-powered systems are currently shipping to customers. Cisco introduced the Silicon One G302, which it calls the first 51.2T switching silicon with 200G SerDes designed for top-of-rack deployments, featuring Cisco 1.6T optics and direct-to-chip liquid cooling integration; the G302 is planned to begin shipping to customers before the end of 2026. Cisco also introduced the Cisco 8001, a Silicon One A100-powered out-of-band management system available as 10G or 1G, bringing SONiC to the management network.
quarterly_data.figure: G300 (102.4T) sampling, first G300 systems shipping; G302 (51.2T, 200G SerDes) shipping before the end of 2026

quarterly_data.quarter: Cisco press release: Cisco Advances Scalability and Openness at OCP 2026 (10-12-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Together with NVIDIA, Cisco unveiled plans to develop the Ultra-Dense Small Form Factor Pluggable (USFP), a 400Gb/s-per-lane capable optical module; USFP is expected to deliver 4x the bandwidth density and 1.3x the power efficiency of 200Gb/s-per-lane optics while keeping the pluggable operating model. Cisco and NVIDIA plan to create an open industry specification for USFP through an upcoming community-led multi-source project.
quarterly_data.figure: USFP 400Gb/s per lane; expected 4x bandwidth density and 1.3x power efficiency vs 200Gb/s-per-lane optics

contracts.source: Cisco press release: Cisco Advances Scalability and Openness at OCP 2026 (10-12-2026)
contracts.signal: In Cisco's OCP 2026 release Microsoft (Anand Ramakrishna, Corporate Vice President, Engineering) announced that Microsoft has moved into production on systems powered by the Cisco Silicon One P200, whose architecture provides the speed and enhanced buffering needed for the scale of its cloud and high-performance services; he called it the next stage in the companies' long-term collaboration.
